calendar.matters:
ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Sep-13-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Cause assigned to Dept. 218 for hearing on a Name Change of a minor. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Mitch L. Lyon. Petitioner, Catherine Kohua Sun was sworn and examined. Father of minor not present in court. Petitioner states that the father lives in China and for the entire life of the child, there has been no contact by the father. Court deems that the father has effectivly abandoned the child. Court order the minor's name changed to Catrina Chiyuan Sun-Tan. Decree signed in open court.
